name: comp-246

frames.best_why: Handle is dragged to 10 with a focus ring around it, showing the slider in use with its ticks and labels.

tagline: Drag the white knob along a track with numbered tick marks beneath.
summary: A one-handle range slider on a dark surface. Its track fills to the left of the knob and a row of ticks with even numbers sits underneath as reference points.
appearance: A bold white label sits above a long grey track with a bright filled portion on the left and a round white knob. Under the track runs a fine row of tick marks, and beneath that the even numbers 0 through 12 in small grey type.
behaviour: Dragging the knob moves the filled portion with it and shows a soft ring around the knob while held. The value slides smoothly between the twelve steps marked by the ticks.
demo_content: Label reads "Slider with ticks"; the scale runs 0 to 12 in steps of one, with only even numbers labelled.
search_phrases: drag to pick a value between 0 and 12
volume style control with tick marks
form control for choosing a number
slider showing even numbers on the scale
round knob on a horizontal track
use_when: Users should pick a small integer from a visible scale and want the steps spelled out.
avoid_when: Precise or free-form values are needed: the ticks suggest fixed steps only.
customise: The label text, maximum value and tick-skipping interval live in the source; the starting value is fixed. Slider colours follow the theme tokens.
weight_why: One track, one handle and a row of static spans; nothing animates while idle.

a11y.note: The slider carries an aria-label, but the tick scale and numbers are hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden.

polish_why: Clean spacing and clear tick hierarchy; the interactive part is a stock slider.
